questions.question: At a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for tailgating cars.
Move when the car ahead of you moves.
Look right, then left, then right again.
Look left, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: Look left first because vehicles from the left are closer to you. Then look right, then left again to catch any vehicles you missed.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the center line means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line on your side means you cannot pass.

questions.question: You may cross double solid yellow lines:
questions.correctAnswerText: To turn into a driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid lines mean no passing or lane changes. You can only cross them to turn left into a driveway or to enter or exit a highway.

questions.question: You may continue through a yellow light if:

options.text: An emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the yellow light appears, you can carefully continue through.

questions.question: Drive below the speed limit when:

options.text: You are on a four-lane road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Conditions are not perfect.
questions.explanation: Drive below the speed limit when the road is wet, slippery, or visibility is poor. You can be ticketed for speeding even at the posted limit if conditions are unsafe.

questions.question: To pass on a two-lane, two-way road, you must:

options.text: Flash your lights at oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the oncoming traffic lane.
questions.explanation: Passing on a two-lane road requires using the oncoming lane. Only pass if it is safe and legal.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light means:

options.text: Stop and look, then go if no traffic is coming.
Speed up to clear the intersection quickly.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed carefully.

questions.question: A probationary license driver may use a cell phone while driving if they are:
questions.correctAnswerText: Making a 911 emergency call.
questions.explanation: Probationary license holders under 21 cannot use cell phones while driving, except to call 911 for emergencies.

questions.question: When two vehicles enter an intersection at the same time, which vehicle must yield?
questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left
questions.explanation: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right when both arrive at the intersection at the same time.

questions.question: License points stay on your record for:
questions.correctAnswerText: Two years.
questions.explanation: Points from traffic violations stay on your record for two years from the date of conviction.

questions.question: Is it legal to drive without liability insurance?

options.text: No, it is against the law.
It is not illegal, but it is not recommended.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, it is against the law.
questions.explanation: You must have liability insurance to drive. The state requires a minimum of $25,000 for one person's injury or death, $50,000 for two people's injury or death, and $25,000 for property damage. This is called 25/50/10 liability insurance.

questions.question: An emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches you on a one-way street. What must you do?

options.text: Move to the nearest roadside and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.
Slow down until the vehicle passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the nearest roadside and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches on a one-way street, move to the nearest roadside and stop.

questions.question: Roads freeze fastest in which areas?
questions.correctAnswerText: Shaded areas.
questions.explanation: In cold or wet weather, be extra careful on shaded areas under trees or buildings. These areas freeze faster than other parts of the road and take longer to dry.

questions.question: What happens to a bicyclist who breaks traffic laws?

options.text: They are allowed to break traffic laws because bicycles do not have to follow them.
Police will always give them a warning.

questions.correctAnswerText: They can receive a ticket.
questions.explanation: Bicyclists have the same rights, duties, and responsibilities as car drivers. Both drivers and bicyclists can be ticketed for breaking traffic laws.

questions.question: Two vehicles arrive at a four-way stop at the same time. What should happen?

options.text: The vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.
The vehicle on the right must let the vehicle on the left go first.
Drivers must use hand signals to communicate.
One driver should go without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.
questions.explanation: Vehicles usually go in the order they arrive at a four-way stop. If two vehicles arrive at the same time, the vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.

questions.question: When passing a large truck, what should a small car driver expect?

options.text: Strong wind gusts from the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Strong wind gusts from the truck.
questions.explanation: Large trucks create strong wind gusts that can push smaller vehicles. Small car drivers should be ready to steer correctly when approaching or passing large trucks moving at high speeds.

questions.question: You reach an intersection with a flashing red light. What must you do?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn right or left because the road is blocked ahead.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must come to a complete stop. Then proceed when the road is clear.

questions.question: At night, where should you look to reduce headlight glare?

options.text: At the center of the road.
To the right edge of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: To the right edge of the road.
questions.explanation: If oncoming headlights are too bright, look at the right edge of the road ahead. Do not look directly at the headlights, as the glare can blind you for several seconds.

questions.question: What is a good rule for passing other vehicles?

options.text: Pass on the right whenever possible.
Drive with traffic and pass only when needed.
Get in front of slow traffic so you can see better.
Always flash lights and honk to warn other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with traffic and pass only when needed.
questions.explanation: Each pass creates a greater chance for a crash. If you drive faster than others, you will keep passing. Drive with traffic within the speed limit and pass only when you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Your headlights are misaligned because one side of your car is higher.
You may damage a tire if you drift onto the shoulder.
Your car may hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto a low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs. They show drivers directions and distances.
questions.correctAnswerText: Green
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background. They show directions and distances to places. They help drivers who are in unfamiliar areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming from both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Left lane must turn left.
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means drivers in the left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection. You do not always need to stop.
Stop only if traffic is on the intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a full stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection go first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes show arrows to control turns from certain lanes. What does a solid red arrow mean?

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a red circular light.
Drivers may turn in the direction the arrow points.
Traffic must stop in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a red circular light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red circular light. When the arrow is red, you must stop. You cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: Other drivers can follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle with two riders is better balanced than one with one rider.
When passing a motorcycle, change completely into the left lane.
Motorcycles always use brake lights when slowing down.

questions.correctAnswerText: When passing a motorcycle, change completely into the left lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use a full lane. Move your whole vehicle into the left lane before you pass a motorcycle on the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bicycle crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles are likely nearby.

questions.question: You want to turn left at an intersection. The light is green but there is heavy traffic coming toward you. What should you do?

options.text: Wait at the crosswalk for traffic to pass.
Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to pass.
Turn now because you have a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to pass.
questions.explanation: When turning left with oncoming traffic, wait for that traffic to go through first. You can enter the intersection to prepare for your turn if the light is green and no car in front of you is also turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter.
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.
